quests.title: Memory's Final Chapter

dialogue.t: "The pomegranate sings, the apples clap..."
Hello, Mr. Khayyam! What are you doing here?
Oh, hello, hello. Child in white, and... *sigh* Apologies, my children. My memories are getting blurry, and names just fade after a while...
Haha... Okay, so you were the...
Yes! We were the Javans - the brave young ones!
Hmm... So, please tell me, do the Aranara still remember me? Do they remember us all?
Oh, uh...
I see... But I can't see them anymore, nor can I know how much they miss me... What a pity.
Hehe... I can't see them anymore. I am too old to see their faces or hear their voices... Gone, it's all gone.
*cough*... Apologies, I have to take my leave now. Perhaps a miracle is my only hope...
One cannot understand or chase after a miracle. The only thing one can do is wait.
Aranaga, he(she)'s here, they're here!
Yeah, here, they're here!
Here you are, Nara {NICKNAME}, White Floaty. Welcome you, the three of us.
Here comes the moon. Now, is the time to plant flowers. Are you ready?
Paimon too!
So... Aranakin, Aragaru, let's start the ritual.
"Be back home, be back home, dreams of the garden, memories of the forest..."
"Embrace, let us:"
"Deeper dreams, everlasting happiness."
"Rejoice, let us:"
"The pomegranate sings, the apples clap!"

dialogue.sit: The Aranara plant the dried flowers. With the ballad echoing in the wind, the flowers come back to life magically...

dialogue.t: Wow... The three flowers are alive again!
Yes, because benevolent, Mawtiyima is. So, she gives memories a chance to resurrect.
Yeah! Even if we forget about you, the memories will... Hmm, be woven into the leaf veins and roots, turn into leaves, turn into tree rings!
Or turn into fatty worms, eaten by other worms. Other worms make things that nourish the plants, and make us grow!
But... You still can't recall anything about us, right?
Yes... Because, memories don't belong to you and me... The stories from the past, we have shared with all grass and trees in the forest...
But it doesn't matter, because we are new friends now, right?
Yeah! New friends!
Hello, new friends!
Hope you'll always remember our song!
Hi, Golden Nara and White Floaty.
Thank you. I can't remember the past, but trusty friends, you surely are.
Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty!
We must hang out like this in the future, too!

quests.description: Though lost memories flow by like water, friendships may be reborn with time…
